title: Media registry
description: Validates the dict that tomllib.load returns for registries/media.toml. Every binary media file tracked by git (for example a golden frame) is listed with its sha256 and size; the gate rejects tracked media that is missing here or whose bytes differ. Only synthetic or self-owned images may be registered, never broadcast pixels, and nothing that carries a restriction tag (ADR 0002). Dates are quoted 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings.

id.description: Stable lowercase identifier: letters and digits in groups joined by '-' or '.'.

license.description: SPDX licence expression or LicenseRef-* id. Original images default to CC-BY-4.0 (ADR 0001).

path.description: Repository-relative POSIX path of the tracked file.

sha256.description: sha256 of the file's raw bytes.

origin.description: synthetic: generated by gbf's own code from synthetic input. self_owned: made by the project (drawings, self-recorded material with consent). rendered_from_registered_data: rendered by gbf from datasets in registries/data.toml that allow redistribution (list them in data_sources).

broadcast_pixels.description: Always false: broadcast pixels are never registered, whatever their source or licence label.

consent_id.description: Reference to the written, itemised consent record, which itself stays outside the repository.

generator.description: Repository-relative script and arguments that produce the file, or 'hand-made'.

restrictions.description: Tracked media must be free of restriction tags.
